using System;using System.Drawing;using System.Drawing.Imaging;using System.IO;using System.Windows.Forms;using Computator.NET.Core.Natives;using Computator.NET.Core.Model;using Computator.NET.DataTypes.Events;using Computator.NET.DataTypes.SettingsTypes;using Computator.NET.Desktop.Bootstrapping;using Computator.NET.Desktop.Views;using Settings=Computator.NET.Core.Properties.Settings;
public static class Program { [STAThread] public static void Main(string[]args) {Application.SetCompatibleTextRenderingDefault(false); Application.EnableVisualStyles(); GSLInitializer.Initialize(); Settings.Default.CodeEditor=CodeEditorType.TextEditor; string folder=Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(),"Symbolic-Baseline-"+Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));Directory.CreateDirectory(folder);Settings.Default.ScriptingDirectory=folder;Settings.Default.CustomFunctionsDirectory=folder;var boot=new WinFormsBootstrapper();using(boot.Container)using(var window=boot.Create<MainView>()){window.Show();boot.Create<ISharedViewState>().CurrentView=ViewName.SymbolicCalculations;Application.DoEvents();window.Refresh();Application.DoEvents();using(var bitmap=new Bitmap(window.Width,window.Height)){using(var graphics=Graphics.FromImage(bitmap))graphics.CopyFromScreen(window.Location,Point.Empty,window.Size);bitmap.Save(args[0],ImageFormat.Png);}window.Close();}Directory.Delete(folder,true);}}
